proposition: In the Sharḥ al-Basmala itself -- a freely offered dedication, not an apology -- Ibn Turka addresses Ulugh Beg as an intended philosopher-king patron, in a line Melvin-Koushki translates as an open declaration that Ulugh Beg's own time has arrived for the science Ibn Turka has long awaited.

mediation.where: "Imperial Talismanic Love" (2019) pdf p.22, citing MS Majlis 10196 f. 332b
mediation.note: The Arabic is given in MK's own footnote; this project has not independently checked the manuscript folio.
